description: Philippe Charlopin-Parizot's 2014 Marsannay Les Échezots is a ripe, expressive Pinot Noir with ruby fruit, floral lift, and carefully integrated oak. The palate combines generosity with a fresh acid spine and enough structure for a savory close.
imagePrompt: Photorealistic studio bottle photograph of a 2014 Domaine Philippe Charlopin-Parizot Marsannay Les Échezots.
palate: Juicy fruit, polished oak, fresh acidity
sommelierNotes: Serve at cellar temperature with roast pork, duck confit, or mushrooms; a brief decant will help the mature fruit open evenly.
